d: Two slender figures with an appearance of early adulthood, wearing featureless, smooth silver metallic masks and sporting honey-blonde hair styled in thick, braided crowns. Their bodies are clad in form-fitting, dark charcoal bodysuits paired with polished silver metallic plating on the shoulders, thighs, and lower legs, while one figure wears a short, golden-yellow cropped jacket. A small, five-pointed red star is centered on the forehead of each silver mask.
